name: AyresTimer
description: Professional mission-critical 64-bit Hardware and Software Timer suite for ESP32 by Daniel Cristian Salgado (AyresNet). Features 64-bit microsecond resolution, silicon Timer Groups (TG0/TG1), high-resolution esp_timer engine, thread-safe FreeRTOS task callback dispatching, real-time jitter telemetry, pause/resume state control, and zero-overhead lightweight timeout and stopwatch modules.
